C-TELEMETRY-VECTOR-PLATFORMS.Summary: User-requested SVG connection artwork and a separate PS4/PS5 platform attribution in the telemetry home widget.

Goals.Goal: Replace the generic devices icon with a crisp monochrome SVG console-to-screen illustration.
Show sourced PS4 and PS5 wordmarks in a localized, noninteractive platform row.

Constraints.Constraint: Retain the selected layout, all connection behaviour, default C and settings, existing uncommitted work and native Flutter architecture.
SVG assets contain real vector geometry, no embedded bitmap; wordmarks preserve source proportions and have accessible names. Wrap at narrow widths.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No connection changes, platform switcher, dependencies, commit or push.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Connection artwork and both platform logos render as SVG on macOS and narrow iPhone without overflow in RU/EN.
Existing connection tests, resource audit and changed-file analysis pass; live screenshots verify the result.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: Dart MCP connection tests and pinned SDK localization generation/analysis.
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Live macOS and iPhone screenshots and runtime inspection.
